receipts.inclusion_reason: Synthetic first-use receipt showing partial completion and initial validator-boundary confusion.
Synthetic keyboard-only receipt showing completion and a different human-authority ambiguity.

review_questions: Which method boundaries were clear in both receipts?
Which misunderstandings differ across the declared conditions?
What additional evidence would be needed before changing the quickstart or authority language?
known_limits: Both receipts are synthetic and do not constitute real user research.
The trials use different interaction, facilitation, and time conditions and are not controlled replications.
Two receipts cannot establish representative usability or accessibility.
